required_markers: ST.read_and_update_sig(page, page_offset, last_sig, curr_sig, delta, GHR)
normal_feedback_callback: cache_fill(evicted_addr) updates FILTER/GHR state; the raw evicted_addr callback is therefore a shared external input, while FILTER/GHR contents remain private
self_target_source_reason: multi-step lookahead updates base_addr, so a later signed delta can return pf_addr to the callback trigger line; the source has no pf_addr != addr guard
queue_effect_rule: CACHE::add_pq merges repeated target lines and the minimum numeric fill wins, so FILL_L2=2 dominates FILL_LLC=4
student_contract: learned count/rank/fill policy over the complete same-page action interface from the chronological DEMAND(addr) and CACHE_FILL(evicted_addr) callback stream; no normal SPP action, threshold, degree, request budget, or private table state is an inference input
